notes.title: Update on 8th October 2024
notes.content:
Update


 Improved the convenience of the stage UI: display of connected seas, display of completed islands.


Bug Fix


 Fixed an issue where the cell UI in the stage would sometimes malfunction.

notes.title: Update on 27th September 2024
notes.content:
Update


 The overall UI has been renewed.


Bug Fix


 Fixed an issue where the credits screen would not function properly under certain conditions. 
 Fixed an issue where some Japanese characters were being corrupted. 
 Fixed an issue where incorrect keyboard behavior would be applied under certain conditions.

notes.title: Update on 21st September 2024
notes.content:
Update


 You can now play the game using a keyboard or a game controller.


Bug Fix


 Fixed an issue where the last selected size was not applied when proceeding to the next puzzle in Infinite Mode.

notes.title: Update on 19th August 2024
notes.content:
Update


 Your progress is now saved during gameplay.


Improvements


 Infinite mode now takes slightly longer to generate, but the difficulty has been increased slightly.

notes.title: Archipel Logic Infinite is Now Available in Early Access!
notes.content:
「Archipel Logic Infinite」 is now available to buy on Steam in Early Access!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097870/386176854ae83697ba2deb998faa70c27af3415b.png

What's in the Game?

36 Main Stages
Engaging Story Mode
Endlessly AI-Generated Puzzles
Innovative Puzzle Mechanics
Minimalist Graphics and Stunning BGM


Streamers & Content Creators
If you stream or make videos and are interested in covering Archipel Logic Infinite, please contact us via the indicated email. archipel2024@gmail.com



Bugs & Feedback
We have a Steam discussion forum right here. Please make use of it to give us feedback on anything. Bugs, new content ideas, areas of improvement, your help is appreciated! We will be releasing a planned roadmap shortly based on community feedback.


We hope you enjoy playing Archipel Logic Infinite!
